details: US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs have recorded a combined net inflow of $281.8 million, marking the end of an eight-week streak of outflows. Bitcoin ETFs attracted $197.4 million, while Ethereum ETFs saw $84.4 million in inflows, signaling renewed institutional interest in the crypto market.
title: US Spot Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs See First Net Inflows in 8 Weeks

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has targeted July 2026 for three crypto rulemaking proposals. These proposals will cover digital asset offerings, broker-dealer custody, and market structure for trading venues, with the goal of bringing more crypto products onshore under clearer regulations. However, the legal authority for one proposal is currently "not yet determined."
title: SEC Aims for Three Crypto Rulemaking Proposals in July 2026

details: Ethereum has experienced an approximate 11% price increase in July 2026. This rally is attributed to rising institutional interest, favorable supply-demand dynamics, and ongoing infrastructure development and roadmap upgrades. Historically, July has shown significant average gains for Ethereum in positive market years.
title: Ethereum Surges 11% in July, Driven by Growing Institutional Interest

details: Bitcoin's price has held near the $64,000 mark, displaying mixed performance amid lingering concerns over a potential Federal Reserve interest rate hike. This apprehension follows robust US jobs data, and investors are keenly watching upcoming US inflation reports and the Fed Chair's testimony for further policy clues.
title: Bitcoin Maintains $64K Despite Fed Rate Hike Concerns

details: Aave's V4 protocol has reached a significant milestone, with deposits exceeding $275 million. This achievement underscores increasing user confidence and strong engagement within the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem, reflecting trust in Aave's capabilities and its continuous innovation in governance.
title: Aave V4 Deposits Surpass $275 Million, Bolstering DeFi Confidence

details: DFINITY has launched MULTI/DEX in "Play Mode" on the Internet Computer, introducing a fully on-chain multi-chain decentralized exchange. This new DeFi application, designed to support spot and margin trading, is now available for community evaluation and marks a new development in the ICP ecosystem.
title: DFINITY Launches MULTI/DEX on Internet Computer for Community Evaluation

details: The 2026 FIFA World Cup quarterfinals, particularly the England-Norway match featuring Erling Haaland, have fueled speculative crypto activity. Solana-based meme tokens like $HAALAND experienced trading volume spikes, and Sorare NFTs linked to players also saw renewed demand, driven by the tournament's excitement.
title: World Cup Quarterfinal Hype Drives Solana Meme Token & NFT Trading
